description:
Returns the structured compliance intake questionnaire schema (categorized sections, field keys, data types, labels, defaults, and option lists) scoped to the requested document category.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'get_questionnaire_schema' BEFORE 'generate_docs_questionnaire' when building dynamic intake forms or interviewing a user step-by-step to collect required legal facts. Call 'generate_documents' directly if you already hold the fields without needing question metadata.

Preconditions & side effects: No required arguments; 'document_type' defaults to 'all'. Read-only metadata lookup.

Returns: JSON object containing 'success: true', 'version', 'document_type', and scoped 'categories' array of question definitions (or 'success: false' and 'error' for unsupported document_type).

document_type.description: Scopes returned questionnaire categories and fields to a specific compliance document type, or 'all' for the complete 4-category schema.

name: get_questionnaire_schema

categories.description: Categorized intake sections containing form field definitions.

fields.description: Form input definitions belonging to this category.

error.description: Validation error message when document_type is invalid.

success.description: True if schema lookup succeeded; false for unsupported document_type.

supported_document_types.description: Supported document_type values returned when validation fails.

title: Get Legal Intake Questionnaire Schema
